content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler multiple vegetables, Stage 2 is a ready‑to‑eat baby puree made from a blend of vegetables, designed for infants aged 6–12 months (stage 2 of weaning). The puree contains carrot, broccoli, cauliflower and pumpkin, steamed and blended to a smooth consistency without added salt, sugar or preservatives.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Combining several vegetables provides a broader spectrum of vitamins and minerals than single‑vegetable purees.
The vegetables undergo double steam cooking, preserving most of their nutrients.
The puree is free from gluten and dairy, making it safe for children with common food allergies.
Packaging is made from BPA‑free plastic and can be reused.
Each 80 g serving meets the daily requirement for vitamin A and vitamin C for infants.

items.title: Rich in vitamin A
items.content: Vitamin A from carrot and pumpkin supports vision development and the infant's immune system.

items.title: Source of vitamin C
items.content: Broccoli and cauliflower are high in vitamin C, which aids immune function and iron absorption.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Fiber from the vegetables helps establish a healthy gut microbiome and eases digestion.

items.title: Low sodium content
items.content: No added salt makes the product safe for the delicate kidneys of young babies.

items.title: Easy to swallow
items.content: The smooth texture reduces choking risk and encourages independent feeding.

items.title: Allergic reactions
items.content: Although the product contains no common allergens, some infants may react to certain vegetables. Discontinue use if rash, swelling, or other symptoms appear.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: Once opened, keep the puree refrigerated and consume within 48 hours.

items.title: Not suitable for children over 12 months without medical advice
items.content: The intensity of some vegetable flavors may be too strong for older toddlers without gradual introduction.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The puree is ready to eat straight from the pouch. If desired, gently warm in the microwave (no more than 30 seconds), stir well, and let cool to a warm temperature. It can be thinned with breast milk or formula for a looser consistency.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened pouches in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and use within 48 hours.
